text.title: 浸水的书页
text.objectives: 永歌森林的学徒梅雷多尔让你搜寻附近桥梁下的水域，帮他找到安瑟隆的元素魔典。
text.description: 如果你拿起武器反抗的话，那些肮脏的家伙必然会逃之夭夭。只是眼下还不是追赶他们的时候。我得找到指导者的元素魔典。我看见某个懦弱的家伙将它扔进了河里，确切位置我就不得而知了。我想或许你能睁大双眼，帮我找找。如果你能找到的话，我会给你一些钱币作为报酬的。
text.progress: 运气不好？嗯，继续找。那本书极为重要，$C。
text.completion: 这本书已经完全浸湿了。指导者安瑟隆会不高兴的。$B$B来，拿着这些钱。我有个主意。
text.completed: 去找死亡之痕的学徒梅雷多尔。

english.title: Soaked Pages
english.objectives: Apprentice Meledor in Eversong Woods wants you to search the water beneath the bridge nearby and bring him Antheol's Elemental Grimoire.
english.description: Those blasted Wretched sure can run fast at the sight of someone who'll stand up to them.  But let's not worry about that now.  I need to find my instructor's elemental grimoire.$B$BI'm certain I saw one of those cowards throw it into the river but I cannot seem to be able to locate it.  I could use another set of eyes.  I'll throw in a bit of coin if you spot it.
english.progress: No luck? Well, keep looking. The book is of utmost importance, $C.
english.completion: The book is completely soaked. Instructor Antheol's not going to like this at all.$B$BHere, take this money. I have an idea.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Meledor in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 托尔瓦·寻路者
text.objectives: 与安戈洛环形山的托尔瓦·寻路者谈一谈。
text.description: 有位名叫托尔瓦·寻路者的猎人最近请求德鲁伊的帮助。他说只有我们才具备必要的技巧与对大自然的尊重。$b$b托尔瓦并不难找，他就在由塔纳利斯通往安戈洛环形山的路上，准确的说，是环形山的入口位置。
text.progress: 你千里迢迢来找我，$C，而且还真花了很多时间。
text.completion: 你千里迢迢来找我，$C，而且还真花了很多时间。

english.title: Torwa Pathfinder
english.objectives: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid.  He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.$b$bThere is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris.  As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
english.completion: You have traveled far to meet with me, $c, and not a moment too soon.

text.title: 学徒的欺瞒
text.objectives: 将安瑟隆的元素魔典交给永歌森林的萦语水池旁的指导者安瑟隆。
text.description: 安瑟隆要是发现他的书被毁掉了，必定会勃然大怒。我有一个小小的建议——别着急呀，我当然会酬谢你的。$B$B把这本书交给安瑟隆，但是别告诉他发生了什么事。如果他问起的话，就说你不小心把书掉到水池里啦。他可管不着你，也就不会把你怎么样的。你会帮助我们的，对吧？我会给你一大笔酬金的！
text.progress: 有什么事需要打断我的演讲，$C？
text.completion: 你说那两个无能的蠢蛋收买你来骗我？你来找我做的非常好，$N。

english.title: Taking the Fall
english.objectives: Bring Antheol's Elemental Grimoire to Instructor Antheol at Stillwhisper Pond in Eversong Woods.
english.description: Antheol is going to fly off his rocker when he finds out his book is ruined.  I've got a little proposal for you; don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.$B$BTake this book to him and tell him nothing of this incident.  If he asks, just tell him you dropped the book into a puddle.  He has no direct authority over you, so there's not much he can do.$B$BAntheol delivers his lectures at Stillwhisper Pond, southeast of Silvermoon.  You'll do this for us, right?  I'll reward you handsomely for this favor!
english.progress: What calls for this interruption to my lecture, $C?
english.completion: You say those two incompetent fools bribed you to lie to me? You've done very well in coming to me, $N.

text.title: 派迪麦克斯任务
text.objectives: 确定你摧毁了那座塔！
text.description: 嘿你，踢倒那座塔！
text.progress: 摧毁那座塔，摧毁这个世界！
text.completion: 你做到了。
text.completed: 去找Kanrethad。

english.title: The Pattymac Special
english.objectives: Make sure you destroy that tower!
english.description: Hey you, knock down that tower!
english.completed: Return to Kanrethad.

text.title: 导师的训诫
text.objectives: 对指导者安瑟隆的两名学生：学徒拉尔雷和学徒梅雷多尔使用他交给你的魔杖。然后将安瑟隆的训诫棒还给永歌森林萦语水池旁的安瑟隆。
text.description: 希望你能学到一点处事之道，$N。不要相信满嘴谎言的家伙。$B$B现在，我想让你回去找那两个愚蠢的学生，使用这根魔杖召回他们的学徒徽章。这根杖子不仅能取下两人身上的徽章，还会给予他们适当的惩罚。$B$B做完这事儿就来找我吧。我会酬谢你的。
text.progress: 你做了我要你做的事吗，$N？
text.completion: 做得好，$N。别担心，他们不会永远变成那个样子。不过，他们的学徒资格在他们自己把它挣回来之前是不会再出现的。
text.completed: 去永歌森林找萦语水池的指导者安瑟隆。

english.title: Swift Discipline
english.objectives: Use Antheol's Disciplinary Rod on his two students: Apprentice Ralen and Apprentice Meledor.  Return to Antheol at Stillwhisper Pond in Eversong Woods with the rod after this.
english.description: I hope you learn a valuable lesson today, $N.  Never trust someone else to lie for you.$B$BNow I want you to go back to my two dimwitted students and discipline them using this wand.  My magic tells me that you'll find them along the road to the west on the other side of the Dead Scar.$B$BCome back to me after you've done this.  I'll give you a small reward for your troubles.
english.progress: Did you do what I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: Excellent job, $N. Don't worry, they're not stuck in that form permanently.  Their apprenticeship, however, won't be restored until they earn it back.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Antheol at Stillwhisper Pond in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 无尽的宴会
text.objectives: 购买一瓶日光陈酿、一些魔泉美味和一捆烟花，然后向永歌森林萨瑟利尔庄园的萨瑟利尔男爵复命。
text.description: 我最喜欢举办舞会和酒会了……这都是为伟大而辉煌的奎尔萨拉斯庆贺与祝福！$B$B但……但是，我手头上还有别的事，所以我希望你能帮我带过来一些货物。$B$B请你帮我从银月城旅店的调酒师桑塔基德那里买一瓶日光陈酿，从远行者居所的萨蕾妮·晨光那里买一些魔泉美味回来，然后再从晴风村的哈里斯·晨行者那里买点烟花。$B$B快点，别让我等急了！
text.progress: 我不是派你去为派对收集更多食物吗？是你吗？喔，我不可能永远记住每个人的长相，对吧？我见过太多……有趣的人。$B$B你想要什么？
text.completion: 你真是个精力旺盛的，年轻$g男人:女人对吗？$B$B这些看起来非常足够。你为我收集这些东西绝对值得奖励，还有一些别的东西我想。$B$B喔，我差点忘了，这是一张派对的邀请函。还有，$C，下次你来的时候记得要穿的更……体面一点。
text.completed: 去永歌森林找萨瑟利尔庄园的萨瑟利尔男爵。

english.title: The Party Never Ends
english.objectives: Acquire a bottle of Suntouched Special Reserve, Springpaw Appetizers and a Bundle of Fireworks, and return them to Lord Saltheril at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
english.description: I like to throw parties... just a little something to celebrate the magnificence that is Quel'Thalas!$B$BBut, I'm in a bit of a bind.  I need you to gather up more party supplies.$B$BFrom Vinemaster Suntouched at the Silvermoon City inn, bring me a bottle of Suntouched Special Reserve.  From Zalene Firstlight at Farstrider Retreat acquire more of those delicious Springpaw Appetizers.  And you can pick up my delivery of fireworks from Halis Dawnstrider at Fairbreeze Village.$B$BBe quick about it!
english.progress: Didn't I just send you out to gather up more party supplies?  Was that you?  Oh, I can't be expected to remember everyone's face, now can I?  I meet so many... interesting people.$B$BWhat is it that you want?
english.completion: You're quite the energetic young $gman:woman;, aren't you?$B$BThis all looks very adequate. You certainly deserve compensation for gathering up all of this for me, and something a little extra I think.$B$BOh, I almost forgot, here's an invitation to the party. And, $c, next time that you drop in make sure to dress up in something a little more... festive.
english.completed: Return to Lord Saltheril at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 碎地者外套
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的林布拉特·大地粉碎者将为你制作碎地者外套，只要你将下列物品带给他：1件被亵渎的外衣，25个受战争破坏的链甲碎片，4个奥金锭和3块熟化毛皮。
text.description: 你可以将为了防守这片土地而倒下的勇士护甲带来给我吗?$B$B护甲已被亵渎，无疑是正被恶魔使用；不过，只要有被战争破坏的护甲碎片，被亵渎的护甲就可以复原并再次被批上战场。$B$B将死者的遗物和净化材料带来给我，碎地者护甲就会是你的。$B$B寻找纳克萨玛斯。
text.progress: <林布拉特对你嗤之以鼻。>
text.completion: 碎地者是最强大且引人敬畏的护甲。我的祖先会为你的成就而微笑的，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的雷布拉特·碎地者。

english.title: Earthshatter Tunic
english.objectives: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make an Earthshatter Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
english.description: Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands?$B$BThe armor has been desecrated and is undoubtedly being used for evil; however, with wartorn armor scraps, the desecrated armor can be renewed and worn for battle once more.$B$BBring me the remnants of the fallen along with purification materials and Earthshatter shall be yours to don.$B$BSearch Naxxramas.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Earthshatter Tunic.
english.completed: Return to Rimblat Earthshatter at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 碎地者护腿
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的林布拉特·大地粉碎者将为你制作碎地者护腿，只要你将下列物品带给他：1对被亵渎的腿甲，20个受战争破坏的链甲碎片，3个奥金锭和5块熟化毛皮。
text.description: 你可以将为了防守这片土地而倒下的勇士护甲带来给我吗?$B$B护甲已被亵渎，无疑是正被恶魔使用；不过，只要有被战争破坏的护甲碎片，被亵渎的护甲就可以复原并再次被批上战场。$B$B将死者的遗物和净化材料带来给我，碎地者护甲就会是你的。$B$B寻找纳克萨玛斯。
text.progress: 不论如何，我们一定要拯救这块土地。
text.completion: 我希望你不会和之前来这里的人有一样的命运，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找 圣光之愿礼拜堂的雷布拉特·碎地者。

english.title: Earthshatter Legguards
english.objectives: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 3 Arcanite Bars and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

text.title: 碎地者长靴
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的长靴、12块锁甲碎片、1块奥金锭和3块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的雷布拉特·碎地者，他将为你制作一双碎地者长靴。
text.description: 你能将那些战死沙场的英雄的护甲给我带回来吗？$B$B那些护甲被邪恶的敌人夺去，早已被玷污了，但是护甲碎片能彻底清洁它们，让我们重新穿着它们杀入战场。$B$B将阵亡英雄的遗物以及那些净化所需的材料交给我，我会为你打造碎地者的套装。$B$B到纳克萨玛斯去寻找吧！

text.completion: 这些靴子注入了我的祖先的力量！睿智地上路吧……
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的雷布拉特·碎地者。

text.title: 失心者的领袖
text.objectives: 将奥尔达隆的徽记交给永歌森林阳帆港附近的维雷迪斯·雪晨。
text.description: 那些失心者囫囵吞枣似的研究着低劣的魔法，尚未察觉我们已经取回了大部分武器。但是，我们不能指望他们一直这么愚钝。现在是时候策划一场决定性的突袭了，目标就锁定他们的首领奥尔达隆吧。他就在船坞旁边那幢建筑物的顶层。把他的徽记交给我，我会酬谢你的。
text.progress: 嗯，你拿到他的头了吗？我没时间浪费，$N。
text.completion: 你击败他了！我的手下果然帮你削弱了他的力量。$B$B我开玩笑的，$N。你做的很好。继续保持你会千古流芳的。
text.completed: 去找永歌森林的维雷迪斯·雪晨。

english.title: Wretched Ringleader
english.objectives: Bring Aldaron's Head to Velendris Whitemorn near Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods.
english.description: The Wretched are so oblivious, gorging on foul magic, that they haven't realized we've recovered most of our weapons.  We can't expect them to remain in their stupor, though.  Now is the time for a decisive attack.  Let us make an example of their leader, Aldaron.  He was spotted on the top floor of the building by the anchorage.  Bring me his head; I'll reward you suitably.
english.progress: Well, do you have his head or not?  I've no time to waste, $N.
english.completion: You defeated him after all!  Undoubtedly my men softened him up for you.$B$BI jest, $c.  You've done well.  You'll make a name for yourself if you keep your nose clean.
english.completed: Return to Velendris Whitemorn in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 骨镰胸甲
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的胸甲、25块皮甲碎片、2块奥金锭和6个熟化毛皮交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一件骨镰胸甲。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: <罗汉让你看他的移动。>$B$B这是什么，$N？为了之后的竞争我必须正中这个记号。
text.completion: 拿去吧，$r。如同先前允诺的，骨镰胸甲。我希望服装专家不在附近。你可能会因为穿着这个被丢进监狱！
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.

text.title: 骨镰马靴
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的马靴、12块皮甲碎片、3个熟化毛皮、2块连结水晶和25金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一双骨镰马靴。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: 赶快把材料带给我不要再浪费我的时间了，$C。
text.completion: 他们穿在你脚上很适合。对了，你最近没有再去提尔之手了吧？
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Sabatons
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Sabatons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Cured Rugged Hides, 2 Nexus Crystals and 25 gold pieces.
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: Just bring me the materials and stop wasting my time, $C.
english.completion: They go on your feet. Say, you haven't been nosing around in Tyr's Hand again, have you?
english.completed: Return to Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 骨镰护手
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的护手、8块皮甲碎片、1块奥金锭和5个熟化毛皮交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一双骨镰护手。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: 没有我需要的物品，你要我怎么做出什么东西来？
text.completion: 这些护手必要时可能可以替换武器。骄傲的穿戴上它们吧！
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Gauntlets
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Gauntlets if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
english.completion: These gauntlets could probably substitute as weapons if absolutely necessary. Wear them with pride!
english.completed: Return to Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 骨镰护腰

text.progress: 没有我需要的物品，你要我怎么做出什么东西来？
text.completion: 腰带准备好了，$N。你有看过这样高品质的物品以如此低价出售吗？
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.completion: The bracers are ready, $N.$B$B<Rohan bows.>

text.title: 末日之影
text.objectives: 前往一处召唤法阵，杀死一名末日之影，然后向东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉复命。
text.description: 在你攻破天灾军团的召唤法阵后，就要面对守护法阵的侍僧了。$B$B说老实话，这些家伙不是人，而是暗影，巫妖王最恐怖的爪牙。使用死灵石可令它们显形，魔法和武器攻击都能取它们的性命。
text.progress: 运气如何，$N？
text.completion: 做得漂亮，$N。随着暗影被摧毁，我们对抗巫妖的胜利希望也得以保存。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉。

english.title: Shadows of Doom
english.objectives: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles, you must confront the acolytes who protect them.$b$bIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
english.progress: Have you had any luck, $N?
english.completion: Excellent work, $N. With the shadows destroyed, our hope of victory against the Lich King survives.
english.completed: Return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 梦游者外套
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的外套、25块皮甲碎片、6个熟化毛皮和2块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵，他会为你制作一件梦游者外套。
text.description: 许多英雄在那场战争中丧生，直到今天还有无数勇士前赴后继，与天灾军团进行殊死的搏斗。天灾士兵们从阵亡的英雄身上脱下护甲，带回纳克萨玛斯进行秘密研究。$B$B取回那些被玷污的护甲碎片和我需要的其它材料，我就能为你打造梦游者护甲。
text.progress: 材料虽然昂贵，但你很快就不会放在心上了。
text.completion: 你的梦行者外套准备好了，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵。

english.title: Dreamwalker Tunic

english.description: Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.$B$BRecover the desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps and supply to me the other material components I require and I will craft Dreamwalker armor.
english.progress: The material cost is high, but soon forgotten.
english.completion: Your Dreamwalker Tunic is ready, $N.
english.completed: Return to Rayne at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 银色黎明手套

text.completed: 去找银色军需官。

english.title: Argent Dawn Gloves

text.title: 霜火长袍

text.completion: 别忘了未受抑制的力量和未被使用的力量具有一样的毁灭性，$C。穿上霜火护甲时要谨慎使用。

text.title: 瘟疫之心长袍
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的长袍、25块布衣碎片、4张月布和2块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的愤怒者玛塔乌斯，他会为你制作一件瘟疫之心长袍。
text.description: 我可不是吹牛，你这卑微的家伙。瘟疫之心套装拥有的黑暗力量很可能会要了我们俩的性命。这也是我要价很高的原因。要死的话，我也得做个富鬼不是？$B$B我可不关心你的死活，除非你照我说的去做。去寻找我需要的材料吧，这对我们都有好处——当然，或者我们都会丢掉性命，但是我已经解释过了……
text.progress: 丰富的材料回来了！你把我要的东西都带来了吗？
text.completion: 你看到了吗？你懂它的力量了吗？净化……真是笨蛋……$B$B<麦特斯不以为意地摇了摇头。>$B$B拿去吧，离开我的视线。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的愤怒者玛塔乌斯。

text.title: 信仰手套
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的手套、8块布衣碎片和4张月布交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的英尼戈·蒙托尔神父，他会为你制作一双信仰手套。
text.description: <蒙托尔神父在你面前做了一个奇怪的手势。>$B$B幸运的$G小伙子:姑娘，你找到那些阵亡士兵的护甲了吗？这些可怜的英雄在那场战争中咽下了最后一口气，还被天灾士兵脱去了所有护甲，连死亡的尊严都没能保住。$B$B把被玷污的护甲部件和净化所需的材料给我带来，你就会了解信仰的含义。
text.progress: 你帮我把试剂带来了吗，孩子？
text.completion: 装备准备好了，$N。用你的公正之火将那些伤害我们世界的人击溃。

text.title: 西部圣殿的麻烦
text.objectives: 与永歌森林的魔网监护者薇兰妮亚谈一谈。
text.description: $N，既然你正好在这儿，我想请你帮个忙。魔网监护者薇兰妮亚的学徒之前曾到我这儿来寻求帮助。西部圣殿那边显然是出了什么麻烦。可是我得忙着招待这些……最最可爱的……矮人朋友。去那儿看看有什么可做的吧。
text.progress: 我需要帮忙而你是唯一可以帮我的人？好吧，看看你能做什么。
text.completion: 看看你的四周，东西都乱七八糟。我们在西部圣殿有严重的运作不良。让我们尽力阻止情况变得更糟。

english.title: Malfunction at the West Sanctum
english.objectives: Speak to Ley-Keeper Velania at the West Sanctum in Eversong Woods.
english.description: Since you're here, $N, I've a favor to ask you.  Ley-Keeper Velania's apprentice dropped by earlier to ask for assistance.  Apparently there's some malfunction happening at the West Sanctum.  I've been a bit busy entertaining our... most pleasant... dwarven guest.  See if you can give her a hand.  You'll find the West Sanctum southwest of here.
english.completion: Look around you. Things aren't exactly in order.$B$BWe have a severe malfunction at the West Sanctum. Let us do our best to prevent matters from getting worse.

text.title: 克尔苏加德的末日
text.objectives: 将克尔苏加德的护符匣带往东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂。
text.description: 护符匣是纳克萨玛斯惟一的遗物。理性告诉你应该摧毁护符匣，令巫妖王再也无法复活。好在你从来不会听从理智的心声。$B$B圣光之愿礼拜堂的某人会出大价钱换取护符匣的。就算克尔苏加德恢复力量又如何？管他的呢！
text.progress: 祝福圣光！你拿着什么邪恶的东西，$g小男孩:小女孩？
text.completion: 我一生中从不期望见到这个东西……$B$B<蒙托神父好像开始流口水。>$B$B喔太好了，你会得到奖励的，亲爱的$g小男孩:小女孩。你会得到丰厚的奖励。拿去。快！

english.title: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad
english.objectives: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.$B$BSomeone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
english.completion: In all my days of living I would have never expected to see this...$b$b<Father Montoy appears to be salivating.>$b$bOh yes, you will be rewarded dear $g. You will be greatly rewarded. Give it here. Now!

text.title: 恐怖之城，纳克萨玛斯
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯需要5块奥术水晶、2块连结水晶、1个正义宝珠和60金币。你在银色黎明中的声望必须达到尊敬。
text.description: 病木林深处就是纳克萨玛斯的宫殿入口。那儿的符文传送门被魔法结界笼罩，一般人是根本进不去的，不过现在不一样了。$B$B我们已经想出了破除结界的方法——奥术遮罩。我对肯瑞托古老的咒语进行了一些修改，使它具备了破除纳克萨玛斯结界的能力。但是你在银色黎明的声望还不高，$N，因此你需要支付一大笔钱。或者当你的声望达到崇敬或是崇拜时再来找我，我会给你打折的。
text.progress: 从没有人能进入纳克萨玛斯还活着讲他的故事。
text.completion: 你会感到一点刺痛，$N。那种感觉就表示它发挥作用了。完成之后，你就能踏上病木林里的符文传送门进入纳克萨玛斯。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.$B
english.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, $N, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
english.progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
english.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 可怕的堡垒 - 纳克萨玛斯
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安琪拉·多桑杜将免费给你秘法掩护。你一定要在银色黎明达到崇拜声望。
text.description: 在浓密的病木林里有个入口通往纳克萨玛斯的可怕堡垒。以前，任何想尝试进入的人都被符文传送门外的魔法守卫挡下来。直到现在。$B$B我们设计了一个方法，透过一个永久的秘法掩护 - 肯瑞托的古老咒语加上一些我自己做的修改。说到这，那个斗篷是要钱的；不过，你对银色黎明的贡献不可动摇!我们会取消所有的费用。
text.progress: 从没有人能进入纳克萨玛斯还活着讲他的故事。
text.completion: 你会感到一点刺痛，$N。那种感觉就表示它发挥作用了。完成之后，你就能踏上病木林里的符文传送门进入纳克萨玛斯。

That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.

english.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
